exact: The effectiveness of AEBS shall not be adversely affected by magnetic or electrical fields.
Conformity with the safety aspects of electronic control systems shall be shown by meeting the requirements of Annex 3.
A failure warning when there is a failure in the AEBS that prevents the requirements of this Regulation of being met.
There shall not be an appreciable time interval between each AEBS self-check, and subsequently there shall not be a delay in illuminating the warning signal
Upon detection of any non-electrical failure condition (e.g. sensor blindness or sensor misalignment), the warning signal as defined in paragraph 5.1.4.1. shall be illuminated.
If the system has not been initialised after a cumulative driving time of 15 seconds above a speed of 10km/h, information of this status shall be indicated to the driver.
A deactivation warning, if the vehicle is equipped with a means to deactivate the AEBS, shall be given when the system is deactivated.
the system shall provide emergency braking interventions described in paragraphs 5.2.1.2., 5.2.2.2. and 5.2.3.2.
The system shall be designed to minimise the generation of collision warning signals and to avoid advanced emergency braking in situations where there is no risk of an imminent collision.
Any vehicle fitted with an AEBS shall meet the performance requirements of UN Regulation No. 13-H
a collision warning shall be provided as specified in paragraph 5.5.1., and shall be triggered at the latest 0.8 seconds before the start of emergency braking
in case the collision cannot be anticipated in time to give a collision warning 0.8 seconds ahead of an emergency braking a collision warning shall be provided
When the system has detected the possibility of an imminent collision, there shall be a braking demand of at least 5.0 m/s² to the service braking system of the vehicle.
The system shall be active at least within the vehicle speed range between 10 km/h and 60 km/h and at all vehicle load conditions
the AEBS shall be able to achieve a relative impact speed that is less or equal to the maximum relative impact speed as shown in the following table
For relative speeds between the listed values (e.g. 53 km/h), the maximum relative impact speed (i.e. 30/30 km/h) assigned to the next higher relative speed (i.e. 55 km/h) shall apply.

The AEBS shall provide the means for the driver to interrupt the collision warning and the emergency braking.
this interruption may be initiated by any positive action (e.g. kick-down. operating the direction indicator control) that indicates that the driver is aware of the emergency situation
The AEBS function shall be automatically reinstated at each initiation of the powertrain
The AEBS control shall be designed a in such a way that manual deactivation shall not be possible with less than two deliberate actions.
It shall not be possible to manually deactivate the AEBS at a speed above 10 km/h.
The AEBS function shall be automatically reactivated as soon as the conditions that led to the automatic deactivation are not present anymore.
A constant optical warning signal shall inform the driver that the AEBS function has been deactivated.
shall be provided by at least two modes selected from acoustic, haptic or optical
The failure warning referred to in paragraph 5.1.4.1. shall be a constant yellow optical warning signal.
Each AEBS optical warning signal shall be activated either when the ignition (start) switch is turned to the "on" (run) position
The optical warning signals shall be visible even by daylight; the satisfactory condition of the signals must be easily verifiable by the driver from the driver's seat.
When the driver is provided with an optical warning signal to indicate that the AEBS is temporarily not available
it shall be possible to confirm the correct operational status of the AEBS by a visible observation of the failure warning signal status
The target used for the vehicle detection tests shall be a regular high-volume series production passenger car of Category M1
The target used for the pedestrian detection tests shall be a child "articulated soft target"
